After that, the code should create a mesh, apply boundary conditions and pressure, and solve the problem. The results should be post-processed to obtain the von-mises stress for the single static solution. The code should also plot the results and compare them with the results obtained from the legacy file reader. Finally, the code should stop MAPDL.

from ansys.mapdl.core import launch_mapdl
import numpy as np

# Launch MAPDL
mapdl = launch_mapdl()

# Set units to US Customary (inches)
mapdl.prep7()
mapdl.units('BIN')  # BIN = British Inch

# Define material properties (Steel, for example)
mapdl.mp('EX', 1, 3e7)      # Young's modulus in psi
mapdl.mp('NUXY', 1, 0.3)    # Poisson's ratio

# Define element type (SOLID185 for 3D solid)
mapdl.et(1, 'SOLID185')

# Create geometry: Cylinder with hemispherical ends (pressure vessel)
# Parameters
radius = 12      # inches
length = 48      # inches (cylindrical part)
thickness = 0.5  # inches

# Create the main cylinder (hollow)
mapdl.cylind(radius, length, 0, 360, z1=0, z2=length)
mapdl.cylind(radius-thickness, length, 0, 360, z1=0, z2=length)
mapdl.vsbv(1, 2)  # Subtract inner from outer

# Create hemispherical ends
mapdl.sphere(0, 0, 0, radius)
mapdl.sphere(0, 0, length, radius)
mapdl.sphere(0, 0, 0, radius-thickness)
mapdl.sphere(0, 0, length, radius-thickness)
mapdl.vsbv(3, 4)  # Subtract inner from outer (start cap)
mapdl.vsbv(5, 6)  # Subtract inner from outer (end cap)

# Glue all volumes together
mapdl.vglue('ALL')

# Mesh the geometry
mapdl.esize(2)  # Element size
mapdl.vmesh('ALL')

# Apply boundary conditions
# Fix one end (z=0)
mapdl.nsel('S', 'LOC', 'Z', 0)
mapdl.d('ALL', 'ALL')
mapdl.nsel('ALL')

# Apply internal pressure to inner surfaces
mapdl.asel('S', 'LOC', 'RADIUS', radius-thickness)
mapdl.sfa('ALL', 1, 'PRES', 500)  # 500 psi internal pressure
mapdl.asel('ALL')

# Solve
mapdl.finish()
mapdl.run('/SOLU')
mapdl.antype('STATIC')
mapdl.solve()
mapdl.finish()

# Post-processing: Get von-Mises stress
mapdl.post1()
mapdl.set(1, 1)
vm_stress = mapdl.post_processing.nodal_eqv_stress

# Plot von-Mises stress
mapdl.post_processing.plot_nodal_eqv_stress(title='Von-Mises Stress (pymapdl)')

# Compare with legacy file reader
legacy_result = mapdl.result
legacy_vm_stress = legacy_result.nodal_stress(0)[:, -1]  # von-Mises is last column

# Plot legacy result
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from ansys.mapdl.core.plotting import general_plotter

nodes = legacy_result.geometry.nodes
general_plotter(
    nodes,
    legacy_vm_stress,
    show_edges=True,
    show_axes=True,
    cpos='xy',
    scalar_bar_args={'title': 'Von-Mises Stress (Legacy)'},
    title='Von-Mises Stress (Legacy File Reader)'
)

# Stop MAPDL
mapdl.exit()
